newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suez Canal Bank to increase capital.
newsitem.headline: Suez Canal Bank to increase capital.

text.p: Egypt's Suez Canal Bank said on Tuesday it was going to increase paid-up capital to 100 million pounds ($29.5 million) through a bonus share issue and private placement.
The bank said in a published announcement that its general assembly approved the issue of bonus shares equivalent to 40 percent of the 50 million pound paid-up capital, increasing it to 70 million.

Three million new shares of ten-pound face value will be offered to existing shareholders to raise the capital to 100 million pounds. The new share is priced at 50 pounds. No date has yet been set for the offer.
The share closed on the stock exchange on Monday at 140 pounds.
The bank also approved transforming its shares denominated in U.S. dollars into Egyptian pound stock, as well as raising authorised capital to 500 million pounds from 100 million.
